basic_info.description: Discover this charming 1BD/1BA home in coveted Corona Heights. Built c.1925, this 835 sqft (per tax record) residence offers vintage details on a quiet, tree-lined street. Natural light floods the home through east-facing bay windows. The inviting living room features an ornate brick fireplace overlooking Mars Street, while a formal dining room offers peaceful garden views. The spacious eat-in kitchen retains its vintage charm with a built-in hutch and provides direct access to a laundry room and the backyard. The home includes one bedroom with a large closet and a full bathroom nearby with a shower over tub. Downstairs, an unfinished 1+ car garage with high ceilings includes a mechanics second bathroom with a shower. The property sits on a deep, 2,735 sqft lot that ascends toward the back, unlocking stunning rooftop, territorial, and bay views from its upper level. Zoned RH-2, this prized location presents the potential for expansion or development in an established and quaint neighborhood.
